title: Lewis Hamilton visits Rafah crossing to see Gaza aid efforts
summary: Seven-times Formula One world champion Lewis Hamilton arrived in Egypt's Arish on Tuesday to see first hand efforts to receive humanitarian and relief aid bound for the Gaza Strip.
